title: The One-Slide Summary
meta: B2 · 约 270 词 · 场景：项目汇报

sections.heading: 1. The Only Slide That Gets Read
paragraphs: A director once told me how she reads a twenty-page project deck.
She looks at the first slide, then skips to the last one, and only opens the middle if something ==bothers== her.
She is not lazy; she has thirty projects to ==juggle==.
Most senior people work this way.
That means your first slide is not an introduction.
**It is the whole presentation, and everything after it is evidence.**
Writing that slide is harder than it sounds, and that is exactly why it is useful.
If you cannot fit the project on one page, you probably have not decided what really matters yet.
The slide __forces the thinking__ that a long deck lets you ==postpone==.
paragraphs_zh: 有位总监跟我讲过她是怎么看一份二十页的项目汇报的。
她先看第一页，然后直接跳到最后一页，只有哪里让她不放心，才会翻开中间。
她不是懒，她手上有三十个项目要兼顾。
大多数高层都是这么工作的。
这意味着你的第一页不是开场白。
它就是整场汇报，后面的一切都只是证据。
写好这一页比听起来难，而这正是它有用的原因。
如果你没法把项目塞进一页纸，那多半是你还没想清楚什么才真正重要。
长篇大论的汇报让你可以把思考往后拖，而这一页逼着你现在就想清楚。

sections.heading: 2. Four Boxes and a Title
paragraphs: Start with the title, and make it a full sentence with your conclusion in it.
Not "Search Latency Project," but "Search is now forty percent faster; we need two more weeks for mobile."
Someone who reads only the title should still __walk away with__ the main point.
Under the title, use four short boxes.
Why we did this, what we did, what changed, and what we need next.
Keep each box to two or three lines, and cut every word that does not __earn its place__.
The last box is the one people ==skip== most often, and it matters most.
**A summary without an ask is just a status report.**
Whether you need a decision, a person, or simply ==awareness== of a risk, say it ==explicitly==.
Then test the slide on someone outside the project.
Give them thirty seconds, take the slide away, and ask what they remember.
If their answer matches your title, you are ready.
paragraphs_zh: 先写标题，而且要写成一个完整的句子，把结论放进去。
不要写「搜索延迟项目」，而要写「搜索已提速百分之四十；移动端还需要两周」。
只看标题的人，也应该能带走核心信息。
标题下面，放四个简短的框。
为什么做、做了什么、带来了什么变化、接下来需要什么。
每个框控制在两三行，凡是没有存在价值的词都删掉。
最后一个框最常被人跳过，却最重要。
一份没有诉求的总结，只是一份进度汇报。
不管你需要的是一个决定、一个人手，还是只想让大家知道某个风险，都要明确说出来。
然后找个项目外的人测试一下这页。
给他三十秒，然后把幻灯片拿走，问他记住了什么。
如果他的回答和你的标题对得上，你就准备好了。

gist.q: 作者说的那位总监是怎么看项目材料的？这说明了什么？
gist.a: 只看第一页和最后一页，有疑问才看中间；说明第一页就是整个汇报，后面都只是证据。

gist.q: 一页纸总结的结构是什么？
gist.a: 一个包含结论的完整句子做标题，下面四个框：为什么做、做了什么、改变了什么、下一步需要什么。

gist.q: 为什么最后一个“需要什么”的框最重要？
gist.a: 没有明确诉求的总结只是状态汇报；需要决定、人手还是风险知情，都要明说。

dictation: It is the whole presentation, and everything after it is evidence.
A summary without an ask is just a status report.
If you cannot fit the project on one page, you probably have not decided what really matters yet.
If their answer matches your title, you are ready.

prompts.q: 电梯里碰到总监，他问你项目怎么样了。用 30 秒按“一页纸”结构口头汇报：结论先行，最后提出一个明确诉求。
prompts.ref: Short version, the new checkout is live in two markets and conversion is up about six percent. We built it because the old flow was losing a lot of users at the payment step. The main open issue is the mobile wallet integration, which needs another two weeks. What I need from you is help getting time from the payments team next sprint. Could you raise it with their director?
prompts.ref_zh: 简单说，新的结算流程已经在两个市场上线，转化率提升了大约百分之六。我们做这个，是因为老流程在支付这一步流失了大量用户。目前主要的遗留问题是移动钱包的接入，还需要两周。我需要你帮忙的是，下个迭代从支付团队那边争取一些排期。你能跟他们的总监提一下吗？

prompts.q: 同事给你看他的项目首页，标题是“推荐系统优化项目”。用 30 秒给他反馈，教他把标题改成结论句并补上诉求。
prompts.ref: The content is solid, but I'd change the title. Right now it just names the project, so a busy reader learns nothing from it. Try putting your conclusion in the title, something like, click-through is up twelve percent, and we need one more engineer to finish the rollout. Also, your last box only shows status. Add a clear ask, otherwise leadership won't know what you want from them.
prompts.ref_zh: 内容很扎实，但我会改一下标题。现在它只写了项目名，忙碌的读者从中什么也得不到。试着把结论放进标题里，比如：点击率提升了百分之十二，还需要再加一个工程师才能完成全量。另外，你最后一个框只写了进度。加一个明确的诉求，不然领导不知道你需要他们做什么。

words.ex: What bothers me is that the error only shows up on weekends.
We postponed the launch until the security review is done.
Let's skip the intro slides and go straight to the results.
This is just for awareness; no action needed yet.
The doc should explicitly say who approves the release.
Can you send me the deck before the review?
My ask is two extra days for load testing.
Every chart in the deck has to earn its place.
I want people to walk away with one clear message.
I'm juggling three launches and an on-call week right now.
